extracted.intended_audience: Applicants preparing an NIH K08 Career Development (PHS 398) grant application
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation and assembly of a PHS 398 K08 career development (Mentored Clinical Scientist) application, including required form sections, budget items, research plan (Specific Aims, Research Strategy), career development/training plan, mentors, and institutional commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Section E, Participant/Trainee Support Costs — enumerated cost categories to report for participants/trainees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Items to list: 1. Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance; 2. Stipends; 3. Travel; 4. Subsistence; 5. Other; 6. Number of Participants/Trainees. Include dollar totals as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Section F, Other Direct Costs — list of other direct cost categories to include in budget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Items to list: 1. Materials and Supplies; 2. Publication Costs; 3. Consultant Services; 4. ADP/Computer Services; 5. Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; 7. Alterations and Renovations; 8. Other 1; 9. Other 2; 10. Other 3. Provide amounts for each and supporting justification as required by NIH budget instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Totals and Calculations
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections G, H, I, J, K: aggregation of direct and indirect costs and fees into totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report Direct Costs (A thru F) as Section G; Indirect Costs as Section H; Total Direct and Indirect Costs as I (G + H); Fee as J; Total Costs and Fee as K (I + J). Provide Totals ($) for each applicable budget period and overall.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals — Euthanasia and AVMA Compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: PHS 398 Vertebrate Animals Section asks: Are vertebrate animals euthanized? If yes, is the method consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If euthanasia is performed, indicate Yes/No for AVMA consistency. If the method is NOT consistent with AVMA guidelines, describe the method and provide a scientific justification for the deviation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Income Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Program Income Section — disclose whether program income is anticipated during the budget periods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer Yes/No. If Yes, provide a table showing Budget Period, Anticipated Amount ($), and Source(s). If No, leave section blank.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (hESC) Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Human Embryonic Stem Cells Section — indicate whether the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If Yes, list registration number(s) of the specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry or check the box that a specific registry line cannot be referenced now and one from the registry will be used. If No, indicate No.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents (Renewal applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inventions and Patents Section for Renewal applications — indicate whether inventions and patents are involved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer Yes/No. If Yes, indicate whether the invention(s) were Previously Reported (Yes/No) and provide the required details as part of renewal reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Change of Institution Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Section to report changes in Project Director/Principal Investigator or Grantee Institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicable, provide name of former Project Director/Principal Investigator (with name fields) or name of former institution. Use appropriate checkboxes and complete the requested fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Supplemental — Introduction to Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Career Development Award Supplemental Form: 'Introduction to Application' required for Resubmission and Revision applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include an introduction describing the resubmission or revision context per PHS 398 supplemental form instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Mandatory Candidate Section including Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide biographical and career-development information, clearly state career goals and how the K award will facilitate the transition to independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Plan Section — Specific Aims page(s) outlining the hypotheses and primary aims of the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State clear, testable hypotheses and 2–3 Specific Aims. Each Aim should include a concise rationale and linkage to overall goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Plan Section — Research Strategy (Approach/Significance/Innovation) required for the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide background, significance, preliminary data as appropriate, detailed methods/approach, and potential pitfalls/alternatives. Show how the strategy addresses hypotheses in the Specific Aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report Publication List (Renewal applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: For Renewal applications, include a Progress Report Publication List.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List publications and progress since prior funding relevant to the renewal. Follow PHS 398 format for renewal progress reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a specific plan for Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a description of planned RCR training activities and timeline, and any coursework or certification to be completed during the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Candidate Information Section — Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe how the candidate will mentor others, planned mentoring activities, and how mentorship skills will be developed (e.g., training/programs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Plans and Statements of Mentor and Co-Mentor(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mentor, Co-Mentor, Consultant, Collaborators Section — include plans and statements from Mentor(s) and Co-Mentor(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentors must document their roles, planned contributions to the candidate's training, oversight plans, and commitment of effort and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors, and Consultants
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement to include Letters of Support from collaborators, contributors, and consultants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters should describe the nature and extent of the collaborator's/consultant's planned contribution and any resource commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of Institutional Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Environment and Institutional Commitment Section — describe the institutional environment available to the candidate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document facilities, intellectual environment, cores, resources, and how the environment will support the candidate's career development and proposed research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutional Commitment section — statement of institutional commitment to the candidate's research career development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide an institutional letter/document showing commitment to protected time, resources, mentoring, and support for the candidate's career goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals (Research Plan)
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Research Plan Section — Vertebrate Animals details required when applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full vertebrate animal protocol information including justification, use, euthanasia details, and compliance with relevant guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Research Plan Section — Select Agent Research declaration if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose any select agent work and provide required compliance information and approvals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/Contractual Arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Research Plan Section — Consortium/Contractual Arrangements must be described.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide details of subawards/consortia, roles, budgets, and letters of agreement or subcontract documents as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Research Plan Section — Resource Sharing required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe plans for sharing data, model organisms, protocols, or other resources per NIH policy and FOA requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Research Plan Section — Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide plans and procedures to authenticate critical cell lines, biological reagents, or chemical resources used in the research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix — permitted materials to be included following PHS 398 appendix rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include only allowed appendix material per FOA and PHS 398 instructions; follow page/format limits and appendix content rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship / Eligibility Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Citizenship field on the Career Development Award Supplemental Form (e.g., 'U.S. Citizen or Non-Citizen National?').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate Yes/No. If No, select the appropriate non-U.S. citizen option (permanent resident, temporary visa, not residing in the U.S.). If award requires permanent residency, indicate expected permanent resident status by award start date if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate's Background and Prior Training/Accomplishments
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative description of the candidate's background, training, previous research experience, publications, awards, and clinical training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a coherent narrative that documents past research productivity, technical skills, relevant clinical experience, and awards/prizes that support the candidate's readiness for the proposed career development plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Goals & Objectives (Long-term and Specific Objectives)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of long-term career goals and listing of specific objectives and additional expertise needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include long-term goals (e.g., independent investigator, clinical care, mentorship). List specific training objectives (e.g., viral latency techniques, immunology, statistics, scientific writing, leadership, mentorship, pedagogy) and how these will be achieved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effort Commitment (Protected Time Requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify percent effort commitment to the K award research and training versus clinical duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The candidate must document dedicated effort (example on this page: a minimum of 80% FTE to the training and research proposed and 20% to clinical practice). Ensure institutional commitment to protected time is documented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Development / Training Activities and Coursework
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed plan for career development activities including hands-on training, coursework, and formal programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List planned coursework, training activities (e.g., graduate courses, Early Career Reviewer Program, K-to-R transition programs), timing (years/terms), mentors overseeing activities, and how each activity addresses specific competency gaps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentors, Advisory Committee, and Collaborators — Expertise and Contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe mentors, co-mentors, advisory committee members and collaborators, including their expertise and specific contributions to the K08.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each person, provide title, institution, area of expertise, and specific roles/contributions (e.g., oversight, sample provision, statistical expertise, access to cohorts). Describe frequency of meetings and modes of interaction (e.g., bi-monthly meetings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Milestones and Timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a timeline of activities and career milestones mapped to years of the award and objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include year-by-year milestones for each objective (e.g., Year 1: coursework, bench training; Year 2: independent analyses; Year 4–5: mentor certification), mentors responsible (abbreviated) and measurable deliverables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims and Methods Expectations (Examples from Aims 1–3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Content expectations for Specific Aims: each Aim should state hypothesis, background, methods, and anticipated interpretation/impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples on page: Aim 1 — correlate LR size in blood and lymphoid tissue with suboptimal immune response using IPDA and matched controls; Aim 2 — assess inducibility normalized to intact HIV DNA, measure cell-associated HIV RNA in vivo or ex vivo; Aim 3 — measure LR size before/after cytokine therapies in clinical trial samples. Show methods, cohorts, assays, normalization and how hypotheses will be tested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significance / Impact Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Strategy should include a clear Significance section articulating public health/clinical impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the knowledge gap, magnitude of the problem, potential to change practice or policy, and how findings could inform interventions or screening (e.g., identifying SoIRs early and targeting for intensified follow-up). Use epidemiologic estimates and literature to justify impact claims.
